findings: LogicalClock validation uses Number.isInteger rather than Number.isSafeInteger. Large accepted values can stop increasing on tick due to floating-point rounding and unchecked addition can overflow; -0 is accepted. Preserve these semantics or separately approve a correction.

reset can move the clock backwards without updating a previously synchronized gate boot tick, and syncToPhysical can re-anchor repeatedly. The synchronization envelope is retained by reference and can change after construction.

Timestamps, rates and envelope values are unvalidated: fractions, negative values and non-finite values are accepted. NaN drift or NaN maxDriftTicks bypasses the strict greater-than refusal; equality passes, negative ceilings reject finite nonnegative magnitudes and infinite ceilings can allow infinite drift.

The existing Fungi asset provides syncGateVerdict and driftGateVerdict over host-supplied integer facts. It does not implement clock mutation, physical-time arithmetic, Math.abs or exception details; integer marshalling must not silently round fractional drift or represent JavaScript non-finite values.

RD-0361 compares Wasm and TypeScript over ten small integer boundary cases plus two synchronization cases; its oracle catches every exception as DENY and does not prove error-code/message equivalence, precision loss, non-finite values, mutable envelopes, reset/resynchronization or RTC quality.

The package reads no physical clock itself. RTC sourcing, nominal-rate/envelope selection and AuditLogger integration remain external seams; current tests do not establish operational timing guarantees.
materialObligations: Preserve Number.isInteger versus safe-integer behavior, overflow/rounding, -0 acceptance and reset/resynchronization lifecycle semantics.
Bind timestamp/rate/envelope domains, non-finite handling, strict equality boundary and mutable-reference custody before authority claims.
Preserve host physical-time arithmetic, integer marshalling, exception/error ordering and the exact sync/drift verdict boundary.
Keep synchronization-gate.fungi non-authorizing and retain TypeScript shadow until separately admitted replacement proof exists.
